faq.q: How much does Wood Injury Law charge?
faq.a: Wood Injury Law publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Wood Injury Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Wood Injury Law publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Wood Injury Law have offices?
faq.a: Wood Injury Law publishes one office, in Mesa. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Wood Injury Law?
faq.a: Wood Injury Law names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Wood Injury Law publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Wood Injury Law publishes 14 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

json_ld_descriptions: Wood Injury Law is a trusted Arizona-based personal injury law firm dedicated to helping clients recover compensation after accidents and injuries. With local expertise across multiple cities, we fight insurance companies aggressively while providing compassionate, personalized legal guidance. No fees unless we win.

Wood Injury Law is a winning personal injury law firm serving Mesa, Arizona and clients throughout the state, including Surprise, Tempe, Glendale, Chandler, Tolleson, Tucson, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Sun Lakes, San Tan, Queen Creek, and Gilbert. Led by personal injury attorney Josh Wood, our firm is dedicated to protecting the rights of individuals and families who have been harmed due to the negligence of others. We aggressively pursue compensation for medical expenses, lost income, future care, and pain and suffering while handling all communication with insurance companies on your behalf. As a trusted personal injury lawyer in Mesa, Josh Wood provides personalized attention, clear guidance, and strong advocacy at every stage of your case. We understand how overwhelming an injury can be, which is why we focus on making the legal process as smooth as possible so you can concentrate on healing. There are no upfront costs, and you pay nothing unless we win your case.
